theorems.name: Submission.tdo_ghe_lintegral_closedBall_ofReal_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Rn n → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ContinuousOn φ (closedBall 0 r) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, 0 ≤ φ x) → ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Rn n) r, ENNReal.ofReal (φ x) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, φ x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
